character: The most extreme lift-served skiing in the Alps. No groomed pistes, no avalanche control, no patrol. One 2-stage pulse gondola (since 1958) accessing 2,150m vertical on La Meije (3,982m). 'Plus Beaux Villages de France'. For experts only, guide essential.
description: La Grave is classified as one of 'Les Plus Beaux Villages de France' and is the most extreme lift-served ski destination in the Alps. The Vallons de la Meije offer 2,150m vertical of entirely unpisted, unpatrolled terrain with no formal avalanche control. Access is via a single 2-stage pulse gondola (built 1958): village (1,450m) → P1 (1,800m) → Peyrou d'Amont (2,400m) → Col des Ruillans (3,200m). A world-unique suspended T-bar reaches the Girose Glacier (3,550m). La Meije summit is 3,982m. Not a resort for beginners or even most intermediates — this is serious high-alpine terrain requiring a guide. A small beginner area exists at Le Chazelet. Also a major ice climbing destination in winter. Pop. 479.

non_ski_activities.off_piste_only: Vallons de la Meije — no pistes, no grooming, no avalanche control. Descents via Trifides couloirs, Chancel route (Banane, Patou, Couloir du Lac), Fréaux Couloir. Guide essential. Glacier travel required at top.
non_ski_activities.ice_climbing: Major ice climbing destination. Routes from <100m to >300m. La Gorge (II/3) to Diabolobite (II/5+). Little winter sun = stable ice.
non_ski_activities.beginner_area: Le Chazelet — small beginner ski area separate from the main gondola.
non_ski_activities.mountain_restaurants: Peyrou d'Amont (2,400m), Col des Ruillans (3,200m), Refuge Evariste Chancel (food and beds).
non_ski_activities.history: Doug Coombs died here April 2006 attempting to save a friend in Couloir de Polichinelle.
non_ski_activities.village: Classified 'Plus Beaux Villages de France'. Population 479. Traditional mountain village with stone houses.

honest_drawbacks: Extremely dangerous — not suitable without guide
No avalanche control or ski patrol
One cable car = queues and wind closures
No beginners, no intermediates, no families
